title: The Voice Note From Tomorrow (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, someone knocked with your best friend's voice. And the real one said he was under your bed.
You don't look under the bed. Nobody would.
You grab your phone and run for the front door.
"Don't!" says the voice outside. "He's lying! I'm the real one!"
And from under the bed, the same voice: "Don't open it!"
Two of him. Same voice. Same laugh. Same bad jokes.
You need a question only the real one knows.
"What did we name the goldfish in third grade?"
Outside, silence.
Under the bed, silence.
Then both of them answer at the exact same time.
"Mister Bubbles."
You sit on the floor. You laugh, because you're going to cry otherwise.
Your phone buzzes one more time. A voice note. From tomorrow.
You press play.
*It's not your friend this time. It's you. "Whatever you do, don't ask about the goldfish."
The knocking stops.
The bed creaks.
And both voices say, "Thanks."
What would you have done?
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
